notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
